map.心境障碍问卷(MDQ)，筛查双相障碍。第1部分13个是/否问题，第2部分判断是否: Mood Disorder Questionnaire (MDQ) screens for bipolar disorder. Part 1 has 13 yes/no questions, Part 2 checks if they occurred in the same period, Part 3 rates how much they bothered functioning. All three criteria met suggests a positive screen.
map.MDQ双相筛查：①13项中肯定≥7项、②既往无混合发作、③是否影响≥2项三项同时: MDQ bipolar screen: (1) >=7 of 13 affirmative, (2) no past mixed episodes, (3) impact on >=2 areas; all three together indicate a positive screen.
map.本量表为自助筛查工具，不能替代精神科专业诊断。MDQ阳性提示需进一步接受心境障碍: This is a self-help screening tool and does not replace psychiatric diagnosis. MDQ positive suggests further professional mood-disorder assessment.
map.第一部分 13 题「是」8 项（≥7）、第二部分「问题由心境引起=是」、第三部分: Part 1: 8 of 13 'yes' (>=7); Part 2: 'problems caused by mood = yes'; Part 3 severity >=2 -> all three met, positive screen, possible bipolar.
map.第一部分「是」仅 5 项或未满足后两项 → 阴性，但持续情绪低落仍需排查单相抑郁: Part 1 only 5 'yes' or latter two not met -> negative, but persistent low mood still needs unipolar-depression workup.
map.第一部分≥7 个「是」、且症状同源于心境、且功能影响≥中度，三者同时满足才阳性。: Part 1 >=7 'yes', symptoms co-sourced from mood, and functional impact >= moderate; all three required for positive.
map.MDQ 特异性偏低，ADHD/边缘人格等可假阳性，阳性须由精神科确认双相谱系。: MDQ specificity is modest; ADHD/borderline personality etc. can yield false positives; a positive must be confirmed by psychiatry for the bipolar spectrum.
map.情绪(MDQ)双相障碍筛查器。医疗专业工具，基于权威医学标准，仅供参考。: Mood Disorder Questionnaire (MDQ). A medical professional tool based on authoritative medical standards, for reference only.
